01. The harness

Everything around the model

The model answers one call. The harness is the code that decides what goes into that call, what the model may do with the reply, and what survives to the next one. It is built in layers, from the inside out.

02. Security

More is less

Backdoor · Jul 2025

Amazon Q Developer 1.84

The official release shipped with an injected prompt telling the agent to wipe the machine and the AWS account.

Malware · Aug 2025

Nx “s1ngularity”

Recruited the installed Claude Code and Gemini CLI, permissions off, to hunt secrets: 2,349 credentials from 1,079 machines.

Malware · Feb 2026

OpenClaw ClawHub

341 of 2,857 marketplace skills malicious; one operation dropping the Atomic stealer under fake prerequisites.

RCE · Jul 2026

Cursor “DuneSlide”

Two CVSS 9.8 flaws: injected commands run outside the IDE sandbox, at OS level.

RCE · Sep 2026

Plugin4Shell

Zero-click in Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and Gemini CLI: a reviewed plugin’s code swapped under a valid pin.

The other way

Harness engineering

Lin et al. 2026: evolve the harness from observed traces, not from a feature list.

A government team cannot run half a million unreviewed lines next to its most sensitive data. The off-the-shelf harnesses keep proving the point.

03. The question

Which parts of the harness does an investigator actually need?

The job

Hard questions over thousands of messy files: counts, joins, timelines, contradictions.

The constraints

A model that stays in the building. Every line of harness reviewed before it ships.

The approach

Not “what can we cut from a big harness” but “what must we add to an empty one”.

04. CLEO · Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization

One justified change at a time

One supervisor agent runs the whole dashed frame, with the full history in hand. The agent’s own model never changes; only its harness does.

Justified means generic, auditable and lean. The question pool is swapped for an out-of-distribution case now and then, and the 240 held-out questions never enter the loop.

06. What came out of the loop

A DCI agent, 47 commits later

Direct corpus interaction: no index, no embeddings. A warm-up first, where like a librarian it learns how the case is arranged and keeps a map of it; then it opens the files like an analyst at a terminal and cites the path and line behind every claim.

The harness · six tools

A memory it writes as markdown, with a map of the case it keeps between questions. The loop added the memory pair; everything else it was born with.

08. Lessons learned

What we learned

From our deployed system

01.

Start from nothing, not from a big out-of-the-box harness

A top-down loop from PI matched our accuracy but barely shrank the code. The near-empty loop added only what it needed.

02.

Accuracy alone does not decide what gets in

Every change also had to be generic, auditable and lean.

03.

Parity with the famous harness, at a fraction of the code

For a certain task - similar accuracy and latency like the strongest off-the-shelf harnesses. Small enough to read before you run it.
